newsitem.title: USA: Inacom to distribute fax, laser printers.
newsitem.headline: Inacom to distribute fax, laser printers.

text.p: Inacom Corp said Monday it signed an agreement with Brother International Corp to distribute Brother's multi-function fax and laser printers.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

"The multi-function fax machines and laser printers are among the fastest growing product lines we carry. This agreement greatly expands our offerings of multi-function products," said Mike Steffan, Inacom's president and general manager of distribution and operations.
Inacom is a technology management services company. Brothers manufactures electronic equipment.
